title: Oven‑Roasted Filipino Pork Tinola
description: Salty, crispy, low‑carb pork tinola roasted in ti leaf wraps, topped with ground poppy seeds and lardons for a post‑workout treat.
instructions: Clean and pat dry the pork tenderloin; season with salt and pepper.
Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium‑high; brown the bacon lardons until crisp, then set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic and chopped onion until fragrant.
Sprinkle ground poppy seeds over the pork and stir to coat evenly.
Place the pork in a ti leaf wrap, add the sautéed aromatics on top, sprinkle the browned lardons, then fold the leaf around the pork and secure with kitchen twine.
Transfer the wrapped pork to a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Remove from oven, let rest 5 minutes, then unwrap the ti leaf to reveal a crispy, caramelized crust.
Slice the pork and serve on a plate with a handful of fresh spinach and a drizzle of the remaining pan juices.
Garnish with extra poppy seeds if desired and enjoy a savory, low‑carb post‑workout meal.
